subject.title: refactor(memory-wiki): move compiled cache to plugin state

question: Should the new public async memory-prompt preparation API be accepted as a general plugin-SDK contract, or should this refactor stay behind a Memory Wiki-specific/internal seam until broader plugin use cases are established?
rationale: The PR adds a new exported plugin API and changes prompt lifecycle semantics across embedded, Codex, CLI, and context-engine paths; source-level correctness alone cannot select the permanent public contract.

options.title: Accept the SDK contract with safeguards
options.body: Approve the public registration after digest-only loading and documented lifecycle/compatibility proof are added.

options.title: Keep it owner-scoped for now
options.body: Rework the change so Memory Wiki owns the asynchronous loading seam without publishing a general plugin-SDK registration yet.

recommendation.title: Accept the SDK contract with safeguards
recommendation.body: Approve the public registration after digest-only loading and documented lifecycle/compatibility proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows steipete carrying the proposed cross-cutting API and Memory Wiki lifecycle design; confidence remains limited without an independent current-main provenance pass.
